name: mini-cloud
description: A private, home-based cloud platform: task scheduling, pub/sub, artifact storage and metrics across your own machines.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @mini-cloud/shared && npm run build -w @mini-cloud/client -w @mini-cloud/reporter && npm run build -w @mini-cloud/service -w @mini-cloud/agent && npm run build -w @mini-cloud/cli && npm run build -w @mini-cloud/web
scripts.start: npm run build && node packages/cli/bin/mini-cloud.js serve
scripts.start:agent: npm run build && node packages/cli/bin/mini-cloud.js agent start
scripts.migrate: npm run build && node packages/cli/bin/mini-cloud.js migrate
